We are also looking for someone who has superb interpersonal and communication skills, given you would be working closely with our customers and engineers to understand, explain and resolve issues, and collaborate with the team to build scalable software. Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are expanding fast. If youre a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

title: Software Developer
description:
About Position: 
 We are looking for an experienced C++ Developer to join our platform engineering team and own the shared distributed messaging and networking library that serves as the communication backbone of our analytics platform. This highly scalable library enables seamless communication between packet capture, protocol analysis, decryption, and downstream processing systems with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability. 
 Role: Software Developer (Senior C++ Developer Distributed Messaging & Networking) Location: Gurugram, Bengaluru Experience: 8 to 12 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Design, develop, and maintain a unified Pub/Sub abstraction layer supporting multiple backends including ZeroMQ, Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, and Redis. Build and enhance high-performance distributed messaging components used across the analytics platform. Maintain and evolve Java and Python bindings for the core C++ library while ensuring API consistency across languages. Design and implement scalable service discovery mechanisms using DNS-based endpoint resolution and REST APIs. Develop partition assignment and message routing strategies for Kubernetes-based deployments. Optimize performance-critical components including lock-free data structures, ring buffers, time-reorder queues, and thread affinity management. Implement and maintain compression capabilities using ZSTD and related technologies. Manage Redis and Redis Cluster integrations including connection management, protocol handling, and operational monitoring. Develop and support REST server and client components along with OpenAPI-based code generation frameworks. Define, maintain, and evolve Protocol Buffer schemas while ensuring backward and forward compatibility. Develop and maintain traffic filtering and event processing frameworks for efficient data delivery. Write comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests across C++, Java, and Python ecosystems. Troubleshoot complex distributed system issues involving networking, messaging, performance, scalability, and reliability. Collaborate closely with platform consumers, architects, and engineering teams to evolve APIs and platform capabilities. Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and technical documentation activities. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing practices, and release management processes. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 8-12 years of software development experience with strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later). Extensive experience designing and maintaining reusable libraries, SDKs, or platform components. Strong understanding of memory management, smart pointers, RAII, ABI stability, and performance optimization. Experience with multithreading, concurrency, atomic operations, and lock-free programming techniques. Strong knowledge of STL containers, algorithms, and modern C++ design principles. Hands-on experience with distributed messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, ZeroMQ, or similar platforms. Strong understanding of Pub/Sub architectures, consumer groups, partitioning, message ordering, and fault tolerance. Experience with high-throughput and low-latency messaging systems. Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, load balancing, and distributed communication protocols. Experience with Redis and Redis Cluster architectures and messaging patterns. Experience building and maintaining Java integrations using JNA or JNI. Experience working with Python bindings through pybind11, ctypes, cffi, SWIG, or related frameworks. Strong understanding of cross-language interoperability and memory lifecycle management. Hands-on experience with Google Protocol Buffers including schema design and version management. Experience implementing serialization strategies for distributed systems. Knowledge of compression technologies such as ZSTD and dictionary-based compression techniques. Experience working with Docker-based deployments and containerized applications. Strong knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated build and release processes. Understanding of Kubernetes deployment models and distributed application architecture. Familiarity with Helm charts and infrastructure automation practices. Experience with build tools such as Make, Conan, Maven, and Python package management. Strong understanding of scalable distributed system architecture. Experience designing highly available and fault-tolerant platform services. Ability to balance performance, reliability, maintainability, and scalability considerations. Strong analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional engineering teams. 
 Benefits: 
 Competitive salary and benefits package Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards Annual health check-ups Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

The role is suited to an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 professional who has transitioned from a traditional .NET development background into a Power Platform-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will design, develop, customize, integrate, and support enterprise solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Power Apps , and related Microsoft technologies. The role contributes to business objectives by delivering scalable applications, improving process automation, supporting low-code/no-code adoption, and helping stakeholders meet operational and customer-service requirements. Software Requirements Required Software Skills Microsoft Dynamics 365: Strong hands-on experience designing, configuring, customizing, developing, and supporting enterprise business applications. Microsoft Power Platform: Practical experience with the platform ecosystem, including application development, automation, and solution configuration. Power Apps: Hands-on experience building and maintaining business applications, including model-driven and/or canvas applications. Microsoft Dataverse: Experience designing data models, managing tables, relationships, business rules, security roles, and solution components. .NET Development: Professional background in .NET development, including experience that supports integration, customization, troubleshooting, or extension of enterprise applications. Microsoft ecosystem integrations: Experience developing or supporting integrations across Microsoft technologies. Enterprise application development: Experience designing and implementing scalable business applications. Development and support tools: Experience using appropriate tools for debugging, source control, deployment, monitoring, and application support. Preferred Software Skills Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Experience configuring, enhancing, or supporting the module. Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Experience with the module is preferred. Microsoft Fabric: Experience with Fabric or willingness to work on Fabric-based solutions. Low-code/no-code development: Exposure to developing and maintaining solutions using low-code/no-code practices. Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform certifications: Relevant certifications are a plus.  MIG Platform Forwarding team, the engine room behind the world's most robust service provider networks. Write high-performance, production-grade code for QoS, Mirroring, Slowpath, OAM, Layer 2 (EVPN, VPLS) and Layer 3 (SRv6, Segment Routing, MPLS) technologies. NPU Data Plane Programming: Implement data plane logic to optimize packet processing. Translate network protocol requirements into efficient NPU microcode and SDK interactions. Debugging & Root Cause Analysis : Investigate and resolve complex software defects found during internal testing or customer deployments. Performance Optimization: Profile and tune code to minimize latency and maximize throughput, ensuring the software meets strict service provider performance metrics. Embedded Development: Strong proficiency in C/C++ for high-performance embedded systems. Proficiency in Python for scripting and test automation. NPU Familiarity: Working knowledge of NPU-based data plane architectures (e.g., Broadcom DNX, Silicon One, or ezChip). Understanding of pipelining, table management, and packet processing flows. Forwarding Protocols (L2/L3): Strong understanding and implementation experience in QoS, Mirroring, OAM, Layer 2 (EVPN, VPLS) or Layer 3 routing (SRv6, Segment Routing, MPLS, IPv4/v6). Implementation experience with TE-Tunnels, GRE tunnels, BFD, BGP Flowspec, ACLs, or Slowpath forwarding mechanisms. Network Knowledge & Debugging : Service Provider Context: Understanding of router deployments in Service Provider networks (Core, Peering). Technical Troubleshooting: Ability to debug issues at the component level, including hardware/software interactions and memory management. Methodology : Modern SDLC: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and code review processes. Willingness to adopt AI/LLM-based tools to enhance coding efficiency and automated testing. 
 
 Minimum Qualifications

Experience working on tools such as Clearcase, Valgrind, DDTS, GDB, etc.

title: Sap Ui5 Developer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : SAP UI5 Development Good to have skills : NA Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary AI Powered Tech Talent Build AI native, enterprise-grade user experiences using SAPUI5 (and the broader SAP Fiori paradigm), combining deep front end engineering skills with agentic AI patterns (LLM-integrated UX, tool-augmented interactions, and evaluation loops). The focus is to move beyond forms and screens into intelligent, guided, and adaptive SAP experiences that help users complete business tasks fasterwhile maintaining performance, accessibility, security, and reliability at enterprise scale. Core Responsibilities 1) Enterprise UI Engineering with SAPUI5 Build responsive, user-friendly SAPUI5 interfaces using MVC architecture, component-based patterns, and standard UI5 application structure. Develop and customize UI5 applications using JavaScript and modern front-end foundations (JSON, CSS), following disciplined source control practices (Git). 2) Data Interaction & Service Consumption (OData-first mindset) Implement robust data flows using OData and service mocking practices for development and testing scenarios (e.g. mock services). Design client-side models, bindings, and interaction patterns that scale across complex enterprise datasets. 3) AI Native UX: LLM-Integrated and Agentic Interfaces (AI native build expectation) Embed AI-driven experiences directly into UI flows (e.g., assist in the moment interactions) where the UI can interpret intent, propose next steps, and generate contextual guidance. Implement tool-augmented UI patterns (front-end orchestration that can call approved tools/services), with clear user confirmation steps and safe action boundaries. Build retrieval-grounded UI interactions (RAG-style grounding) where AI outputs must stay tied to enterprise knowledge and business context, with deterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak. 4) Testing, Quality & UX Reliability Build automated test coverage with a strong testing approach for UI components using unit and acceptance testing patterns (e.g., QUnit and one page acceptance tests/OPA style approaches). Optimize performance and maintainability: reduce UI bloat, apply reusable components, and enforce consistent coding standards for long-term supportability. 5) SAP Fiori-aligned Experience Design Apply SAP Fiori s design principles and UX paradigm to deliver role-based, consistent experiences across devices, aligned to modern SAP UX expectations. Understand the ecosystem positioning of SAPUI5 and OpenUI5 and make informed choices based on enterprise constraints and licensing contexts. 6) Iteration, Delivery & Collaboration Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate with business stakeholders—then harden into production-ready UI solutions with observability and regression testing for both UI and AI behaviors. Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have) Strong hands-on expertise in SAP UI5 / SAPUI5 development and enterprise UI engineering fundamentals. Mastery of MVC architecture, responsive UI construction, and component-driven development in SAP UI5 contexts. Solid implementation experience with OData and service mocking approaches for development/test workflows. Strong front-end foundations: JavaScript + JSON + CSS, with Git-based collaboration. AI-native build capability: designing UX that integrates LLM behaviors with grounding, tool use, and evaluation loops (owned by the role). (AI native expectation not a claim about a specific SAP feature.) Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills SAP Fiori design paradigm familiarity and ability to translate UX principles into scalable UI solutions. Testing depth for SAPUI5 applications using the testing approaches referenced in learning assets. Understanding of SAPUI5 vs OpenUI5 positioning and implications for enterprise delivery. What This Role Does Not Center On Not limited to AI-assisted coding or only using copilots this role builds AI-native UI behaviors and owns their quality (grounding, safety boundaries, evaluation). Not focused on model training emphasis is on productizing intelligent experiences in the UI layer with reliable integration patterns. Value Delivered Enterprise SAP applications with modern, responsive SAPUI5 interfaces aligned to SAP Fiori UX expectations. Faster user outcomes through AI-native in-flow guidance and agentic task completion patterns (grounded, safe, and measurable). Higher reliability via disciplined testing practices for UI components and acceptance flows. Additional Information A 15 years full time education is required" Premium SAP UI5 Development

BigCommerce Engineer

 About the Role

 We're looking for an experienced BigCommerce Engineer to design, build, and maintain our ecommerce storefront and its supporting integrations. You'll work at the intersection of frontend storefront development, backend API integrations, and platform architecture to deliver a fast, reliable, and conversion-focused shopping experience.

 What You'll Do
 * Develop and maintain custom storefronts using BigCommerce's Stencil framework (Handlebars, SCSS, JavaScript)
 * Build and extend features using the BigCommerce Storefront API, Catalog API, and Checkout
 * Integrate BigCommerce with third-party systems (ERP, CRM, PIM, OMS, payment gateways, tax engines, shipping providers) via REST/GraphQL APIs

 * Optimize site performance, Core Web Vitals, and mobile responsiveness

 * Troubleshoot production issues across storefront, backend integrations, and third-party services
 * Write clean, tested, well-documented code and participate in code reviews
 * Stay current with BigCommerce platform updates, API changes, and ecommerce best practices

 Required Qualifications
 * 3+ years of experience building and customizing BigCommerce storefronts (custom development)
 * Experience with developing microservices using Kotlin , following a Test Driven Development approach
 * Hands-on experience with BigCommerce's REST and GraphQL APIs (Catalog, Orders, Customers, Checkout)

 * Experience with version control (Git) and modern development workflows (CI/CD)
 * Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across frontend and backend layers

 Nice to Have

 * Familiarity with Node.js, React, or other JS frameworks
 * Background with other ecommerce platforms (Shopify Plus, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Magento, SAP Commerce) for context/migration work

title: Agentic AI Developer
description:
We're looking for an Agentic AI Developer who lives at the intersection of applied LLM engineering and production software. You'll design and ship the AI agents and orchestration flows at the core of Synthetix reasoning loops, tool use, multi-agent coordination, memory, and the governance rails that keep them trustworthy. You're comfortable across the stack, but your center of gravity is agent creation : turning a capability into a reliable, observable, evaluable agent. This is a hands-on builder role — you'll prototype fast, harden what works, and own agents from design through production. What You'll Do Design, build, and ship AI agents using modern agent frameworks — OpenAI Agents SDK, Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), Microsoft Agent Framework / AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalents — picking the right tool for each problem. Architect multi-agent orchestration and stateful workflows with LangGraph, LangChain , and similar frameworks: planning, routing, hand-offs, retries, and durable long-running execution. Implement robust tool / function calling, structured outputs, and external-system integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and connectors. Build the retrieval and memory layers — RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and short- and long-term agent memory. Bake in governance from day one: guardrails, policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, audit trails, and safe-failure behavior — the governed in governed orchestration. Stand up evaluation and observability — agent evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, and telemetry (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry) — to measure and continuously improve agent reliability. Integrate agents into full-stack applications across APIs, services, and front-end surfaces, collaborating closely with platform, product, and design. Optimize for cost, latency, and quality across model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic / Claude, Google / Gemini, and open-weight models). What You'll Bring 3+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful recent hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-powered applications . Strong Python (the working language of agent development) and solid TypeScript / JavaScript for full-stack integration. Hands-on experience with at least one agent framework / SDK (OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and one orchestration framework ( LangChain / LangGraph or equivalent). A solid grasp of LLM building blocks: prompting, function / tool calling, structured outputs, context-window management, RAG, and embeddings / vector databases. Full-stack fluency: REST / async APIs (FastAPI, NestJS, or similar), relational databases (PostgreSQL), and enough front-end (React) to build and integrate end-to-end. Familiarity with cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containers (Docker), and CI/CD. A product mindset, strong debugging instincts, and the judgment to make non-deterministic systems behave reliably. Nice to Have Experience with agent evaluation and LLM observability tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, and similar). Experience with MCP , Temporal or other durable-execution engines, and event-driven architectures. Exposure to enterprise / regulated environments — SSO, RBAC, data governance, and compliance. Fine-tuning, prompt-optimization, or model-routing experience. Open-source contributions in the agent / LLM ecosystem.

Key Skills: Agentic AI,Langgraph,Langchain,Model Context Protocol (MCP),Java,Adk,React.js,Spring

 Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. We're looking for a Senior Software Developer with strong, current C++ expertise and a genuine upskilling mindset. Testing:  Solid grounding in test automation principles —  unit and integration testing are both mandatory Code quality:  Working knowledge of clean code principles and demonstrated ability to design and maintain clean software architecture. **About OutSystems**
 OutSystems enables enterprise teams to build AI\-powered applications and agents that reduce manual work, streamline internal operations, and accelerate impact. A proven low\-code foundation combined with agentic AI and AI app generation capabilities empowers teams to move up to 10x faster with the assurance of security, scalability, and governance built in.
   

  

 As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities—but inside the enterprise, things are moving fast and feeling chaotic. Some early adopters are making progress in production, but for many, AI tools are sprawling without governance, data isn't ready, and talent isn't there yet. Enterprises are still drowning in application backlogs and struggling with legacy systems. But with the right platform, AI doesn't have to add to the chaos. It can become the breakthrough that brings clarity—and drives real, enterprise\-wide impact. At OutSystems, we've built that platform, providing the tools necessary for enterprises to overcome these hurdles.

 OutSystems is a truly global company, with more than 850,000 developer community members, 1,700 employees, more than 500 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and of course has a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees.
   

  

**About Agentic Nexus Team**
 Agentic Nexus is building the next generation of AI\-aware data management solutions, empowering businesses to unlock the full potential of their data through intelligent retrieval, semantic understanding, and agentic automation. Our innovative platform integrates enterprise context graphs, semantic search, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and observability\-first design to deliver scalability, security, and ease of use. We're transforming how organizations store, process, analyze, and intelligently act on their information. Join a passionate team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and making a real impact in the AI revolution.
   

  

****The Role****
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the design, development, and implementation of core AI\-powered features within the Agentic Nexus platform. You will work on complex technical challenges spanning semantic search, RAG systems, knowledge graphs, and enterprise AI agents, while establishing observability standards. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and drive innovation in how enterprises leverage AI for intelligent data management and agentic automation.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Design and implement core AI platform features: semantic search, RAG systems, and enterprise context graphs that power intelligent agentic workflows.
* Lead technical design for enterprise knowledge graph solutions, integrating foundation models and ML systems with scalable data infrastructure.
* Build comprehensive observability using OpenTelemetry across distributed agentic systems; ensure visibility into agent decision\-making and data retrieval.
* Mentor engineers on building AI\-aware systems, drive code quality, and contribute to continuous platform improvement.
* Leverage AI\-driven development tools (Claude, Cursor) to accelerate development while maintaining architectural integrity and performance standards.
* Knowledge of product development best practices, continuous delivery, and testing;
* Last\-line troubleshooting of complex incidents created by the solutions developed in your team, having on\-call support rotation;
* Act as a technical mentor, driving best practices in development and continuous delivery.


**Qualifications (Required)**
* Bachelor or Master's Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or similar. Equivalent experience in software development will also be considered for exceptional candidates
* 5\+ years in software development: distributed systems, cloud\-native architectures, or data\-intensive applications.
* Proficiency in C\#, Go, Python and Java.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS cloud platforms and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and messaging technologies such as Kafka/NATS.
* Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and databases (relational and/or NoSQL).
* Proven ability to debug complex issues, work independently, and drive projects to completion.
* An active learner of emerging technologies and frameworks, eager to stay at the forefront of technological advancements.
* Great troubleshooting skills, with a knack for diagnosing and resolving intricate issues quickly and effectively.


**Specialized Qualifications (Strongly Preferred)**
* Semantic Search \& RAG: Production experience with embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, S3 Vector), and RAG systems.
* Enterprise Knowledge Graphs: Experience with graph databases (Neo4j, Neptune) and context graphs for representing enterprise relationships.
* AI Agentic Platforms: Familiarity with agentic AI systems and autonomous agent frameworks.
* OpenTelemetry \& Observability: Proficiency with OTel for distributed tracing, structured logging, and metrics across complex systems.
* AI\-Driven Development: Experience with Claude, Cursor, or similar AI coding assistants.

description:
About the Role: Zinnov is hiring for the role of ServiceNow Developer on behalf of a global enterprise client leading healthcare and medical technology company where technology sits at the center of everything: powering core business operations and shaping digital solutions for global patient care. This role is a key part of establishing the company's new India Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Bengaluru, driving enterprise technology, digital transformation, and innovation for global operations. 
 Why this matters This role represents a rare opportunity to join the India GCC from its early stages, working alongside global teams, helping establish new capabilities, and contributing to the future of one of the world's largest, most comprehensive companies in its industry. 
 What you'll do: As a ServiceNow Developer, you will build and maintain solutions across ITSM, ITOM, Discovery & Event Management, and HRSD, working closely with the Development Tech Lead and Technical Architect to deliver against the platform roadmap. You will bring an AI-first mindset to every build, leveraging ServiceNow's native AI capabilities to automate and enhance processes alongside strong hands-on scripting, integration, and Service Portal development skills. 
 Key Responsibilities: Solution Development: Build and maintain solutions across ITSM, HRSD, ITOM, and Discovery & Event Management, configuring workflows and Flow Designer flows in line with an AI-first approach. Process Automation: Identify and implement opportunities to use ServiceNow's native AI capabilities (Virtual Agents, Predictive Intelligence, AI-powered search) to automate manual steps. Analytics & Reporting: Develop and analyze reports and Performance Analytics dashboards to surface data-driven insights for process governors and stakeholders. Portal Enhancement: Build and enhance Service Portal and Employee Center experiences, applying modern web technologies to deliver responsive, intuitive interfaces. Technical Debt Reduction: Analyze business requirements and map them to out-of-the-box (OOTB) functionality, transitioning custom configurations to standard modules. Platform Maintenance: Support ongoing platform maintenance, annual ServiceNow upgrades, SLA-based issue resolution, and continuous improvement across modules.
